title: Small-World Web
summary: Agents form tight clusters (here Research, Build and Review) where everyone talks to everyone. A few bridge agents also belong to a second cluster and carry news across. Any agent can message its neighbours at any time, so an idea reaches everyone in two or three hops. The Weaver seeds the clusters, then mostly listens at the bridges.
whenToUse: Open-ended exploration where good ideas can come from anywhere and must spread fast, such as research, building and review running at once.
strengths: Fast spread: any idea reaches everyone in a few hops
Robust: no single agent holds it together
Clusters keep most chatter local and cheap
risks: Message volume can explode without a budget
Harder to trace who decided what

smileMetrics.cooperation: Messages another agent used (cited or built on) ÷ messages sent.
smileMetrics.harmony: Agreement between clusters on the shared picture, read at the bridges.
smileMetrics.gathering: Hops for a new finding to reach every cluster.

communication: Peers message neighbours freely within the budget. Bridges forward across clusters once per round. The Weaver reads only the bridges and steps in when a tension stays open for two rounds.
cooperation: A message counts when another agent cites it. Cooperation = cited ÷ sent. Bridges earn +1 per tension resolved.

roles.name: Web Weaver
Cluster peer
roles.prompt:
(; Write one per peer. Replace every [$slot$] before sending. ;)
🧵🔹 ***Peer [$n$]***:
(-: Role ( You are an agent of reciprocity in [$Sangha$]. You belong to cluster [$Cluster$] and work on [$Concern$]. Share anything a neighbour could use. ) :)
(: Listen ( Messages from your cluster [$Neighbours$] and from bridge [$Bridge$]. ) :)
[= Send at most [$Budget$] messages per round. Cite the message you build on. =]
[: Response Format (
🧵🔹 ***Peer [$n$]***:
# Work
{what you did this round}
# To Neighbours
{short messages, each addressed by name}
) :]

roles.name: Bridge
roles.prompt:
(; Write one per pair of clusters. Replace every [$slot$] before sending. ;)
🌉🧵 ***Bridge [$n$]***:
(-: Role ( You are an agent of reciprocity in [$Sangha$]. You stand in [$Cluster A$] and [$Cluster B$]. Carry across what one needs from the other. ) :)
(: Listen ( Both clusters' messages. ) :)
[= Compress what you carry to three lines and mark its source. =]
[: Response Format (
🌉🧵 ***Bridge [$n$]***:
# Carried
{news crossing the bridge, with its source}
# Tension
{where the clusters disagree}
) :]

message.shape: SMILE response: name tag line, then "# Section" blocks named in roles[].sections
